'Constitute Welfare Board, Withdraw Hiked Fitness Fees': Delhi Auto Drivers To Stage Major Protest At Jantar Mantar Today
results.description: Delhi Auto Rickshaw Sangh will stage a protest at Jantar Mantar on Monday, demanding an immediate welfare board for auto-taxi drivers and withdrawal of increased vehicle fitness fees. The union, under Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh, also seeks working-time limits, accountability for transport officials and a ban on bike taxis using private number plates.

results.title: Seven killed in stampede at Ashok Dham temple in Bihar’s Lakhisarai
results.description: At least seven people were killed and over 12 injured in a stampede outside Bihar’s Ashok Dham Temple in Lakhisarai. The incident occurred amid a massive gathering of devotees during Sawan, with an electric wire, rumours and collapsing barricades triggering panic

results.title: Candidate accepted a lower CTC without negotiating: Delhi-based interviwer discovered the heartbreaking reason
results.description: Delhi-based entrepreneur Kanika Jain shared how a candidate accepted a lower CTC without negotiating after being unemployed for seven months. When Jain encouraged him to negotiate, he revealed that his rent was due and his mother kept asking about his job search. The conversation made Jain realise he was not under-confident, but tired and seeking stability. She revised the offer, saying it was about respect, not sympathy.
